title: Signed two-sided tail bounds
statement: For every real threshold $t$, natural number $n$, and sign vector $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, the difference between the upper-tail indicator at $x$ and the upper-tail indicator at $-x$ lies in $[-1,1]$. Here the upper-tail indicator is one when the normalized Rademacher sum is strictly greater than $t$, and zero otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
